agent.name: billing-reconciler
agent.purpose: Reconcile canonical subscription state against the external billing system nightly. Produces a reconciliation proposal for human review. Never writes back to the external billing system.

invariants: Read-only against the external billing system.
All proposals require human approval before any corrective action ships.
First live correction in any new reconciliation type requires two dry-runs.

moduleConsumes.usage: surface churn signals on identity dashboards
derive identity revocation triggers on offboarding

hitlConstraints: All deploys to production go through a human approval. No schedule-only deploy path.
Sub-cognition modules (identity, billing, deployment) inherit the platform module's HITL invariants.

moduleExposes.description: Capacity, incident posture, deploy frequency, identity drift summary
